title: Route Handler Specification
description: Schema for specifying a Route Handler to be implemented by Agente04_DevBackend. Enforces the thin-handler constraint — Route Handlers must authenticate, parse, delegate, and respond. Nothing more.

route_path.description: The Next.js App Router file path for this route. Must be inside app/api/.

http_method.description: HTTP method this handler responds to.

auth_required.description: Whether this endpoint requires an authenticated session. If true, 401 is returned for unauthenticated requests.

delegates_to.description: The features/ service or action function this handler delegates to. Route handlers must NOT contain business logic — they delegate.

request_body_schema.description: Name of the Zod schema used to validate the request body (for POST/PUT/PATCH).

query_params_schema.description: Name of the Zod schema used to validate query parameters (for GET with filters).

max_lines.description: Maximum allowed lines of code for this handler. Should be ≤ 30 for a properly thin handler.

returns_status_codes.description: HTTP status codes this handler returns.

is_cron_route.description: Whether this is a cron job route. If true, guardCron() must be the first call.

is_webhook_route.description: Whether this is a webhook receiver. If true, auth pattern differs (signature verification instead of session).
